title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Analista de Suporte | Service Desk (N2) | Microsoft 365 + ERPs | Híbrido RJ
description:
Analista de Suporte (Jr Forte / Pleno Leve) | M365 + Service Desk + ERPs + RMM/EDR | Híbrido RJ | Campo pontual

Salário: R$ 3.800 a R$ 4.200 (CLT)

Progressão: revisão em 45 e 90 dias (metas objetivas)


Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Atuação em formato híbrido: 3 dias presenciais no escritório e 2 dias em home office .
  • Os dias de home office são variáveis , definidos pela empresa conforme demandas de atendimento externo, com alinhamento prévio com o colaborador.
  • A função envolve atendimentos externos em clientes , com frequência média de 1 a 2 vezes por semana .


Sobre a GuidelineIT

Na GuidelineIT, a gente faz suporte de um jeito raro: com padrão, processo e cabeça de melhoria contínua. Somos uma empresa de serviços gerenciados (MSP) que atende clientes exigentes e ambientes variados, usando ferramentas e disciplina (ITSM, KB, monitoramento e segurança de endpoint) para resolver de verdade e reduzir reincidência, não só “apagar incêndio”. Aqui você vai trabalhar perto de gente boa, aprender rápido com casos reais, e crescer por entrega e evolução técnica, não por politicagem.


Missão

Assumir a rotina de suporte com padrão GuidelineIT: resolver bem, registrar melhor ainda e reduzir reincidência , atendendo usuários exigentes e clientes VIP com processo, clareza e disciplina de SLA.


O que você vai fazer80% do tempo (operação e suporte técnico)
  • Atender e conduzir chamados ponta a ponta (incidente/requisição) via ferramenta de Service Desk, com registro completo , evidências (prints/logs) e follow-up.
  • Suporte a Windows 10/11 , aplicativos, impressão e periféricos (diagnóstico e correção).
  • Suporte a Microsoft 365 : criação/ajuste de usuários e licenças, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint (acesso, sincronização, permissões e troubleshooting comum).
  • Rotinas básicas de Windows Server / Active Directory : usuários, grupos, permissões e noções de GPO/NTFS quando aplicável.
  • Suporte técnico a aplicações de negócio (ERPs) como Nasajon, Systak e Alterdata : instalação/atualização do client, configuração básica, validação de acesso e conectividade, troubleshooting de erros comuns e abertura de chamados com evidências junto ao fornecedor quando necessário.
  • Importante: não é suporte funcional (rotinas contábeis/fiscais/folha). O foco é garantir que o sistema rode e o incidente seja conduzido com padrão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de monitoramento e gestão de endpoints via RMM e EDR (ex.: Bitdefender GravityZone ou similar ): triagem de alertas, checagem de status/atualizações, aplicação de ações básicas e escalonamento com evidências quando necessário.
  • Atualizar e criar artigos na Base de Conhecimento (KB) usando template padrão: passos reproduzíveis e específicos por cliente.


20% do tempo (campo e rotina operacional)
  • Atendimentos externos pontuais: onboarding, validação local, troca de equipamento, ajustes simples e apoio em implantação.
  • Manutenção básica de notebooks (diagnóstico e trocas simples) e organização de ativos/equipamentos.
  • Apoio em projetos de implementação e onboarding de clientes (checklists e padronização).


Requisitos (precisa ter)
  • Experiência real com Service Desk/ITSM e disciplina de SLA/follow-up.
  • Boa base em Windows 10/11 e troubleshooting.
  • Noções práticas de Microsoft 365 (Teams/OneDrive/SharePoint no dia a dia).
  • Base de rede (DNS/DHCP/TCP-IP) para diagnóstico e triagem.
  • Comunicação clara com usuário (conduz solução com educação e objetividade).


Diferenciais
  • Ferramentas ITSM (GLPI/Jira/Freshservice/Zendesk/ServiceNow ou similar)
  • Experiência com RMM (monitoramento, inventário, rotinas e automações simples)
  • Experiência com EDR (Bitdefender ou similar): políticas e tratamento de alertas
  • Noções de firewall/pfSense, backup e Linux básico (terminal, arquivos)
  • Certificações Microsoft ou ITIL (se tiver algo acima disso, melhor ainda)
  • Experiência anterior com suporte técnico a ERPs (instalação, logs, evidências, interface com fornecedor)


O que NÃO é
  • Não é vaga de SOC/Analista de Segurança . O foco é operação, triagem, execução básica e escalonamento com padrão.
  • Não é vaga de Azure/Cloud Engineer “faz tudo”.


Benefícios
  • Subsídio para cursos e estudos
  • Bonificação por certificações Microsoft e similares
  • Comissão por indicação de clientes
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Day off mensal


Como avaliamos (sem enrolação)
  • Teste prático (cenário real): troubleshooting + escrita de ticket completo (diagnóstico, evidência e fechamento)
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Etapa comportamental com relatos reais (respostas genéricas geradas por IA são desclassificadas)

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.

  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Jornalista Sênior | Head de Projetos de Conteúdo Digital & Comercial

• Garantia de alinhamento entre conteúdo, comercial e entregas

• Relacionamento e acompanhamento de projetos com marcas das quais Matheus Baldi tem contrato

Perfil que buscamos:

• Formação em Jornalismo ou Comunicação Social

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência digital comprovada

• Excelente redação e domínio narrativo

• Experiência com jornalismo de celebridades e bastidores política/mercado

• Experiência organizando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

• Forte capacidade comercial e de negociação

• Conforto em trabalhar com metas e geração de receita

• Alta capacidade de organização e controle de dados

• Autonomia e postura resolutiva

• Mentalidade de dono e visão estratégica

Criatividade é bem-vinda, mas organização, execução e comercial são as prioridades.

Atenção! Formato híbrido, com predominância de trabalho remoto (cerca de 80%) e encontros presenciais pontuais. Mas, é preciso que more em São Paulo (capital) ou na Grande São Paulo.


Modelo de remuneração:

Prestação de serviço (PJ), com remuneração fixa mensal compatível com senioridade.

Além do fixo:

Participação de 3% sobre todos os contratos captados e vendidos diretamente pelo(a) profissional .

O pagamento da participação acompanha a forma de recebimento acordada com o cliente, respeitando parcelas e prazos definidos em contrato.

Buscamos alguém que compreenda metas, receita e crescimento sustentável.


Não é a vaga ideal se:

• Você prefere apenas escrever e não negociar

• Não tem experiência real em vendas ou captação

• Nunca organizou múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

• Precisa de supervisão constante

• Trabalha apenas por carga horária

• Não tem experiência sólida em jornalismo digital

Essa posição exige maturidade profissional, responsabilidade e visão de negócio.


Como se candidatar:


Favor enviar:


  • Portfólio com 3 a 8 links de trabalhos publicados (matérias, vídeos, campanhas e/ou projetos digitais), indicando sua função em cada um deles.
  • Breve descrição de um projeto que você estruturou do zero
  • Exemplo de propostas comerciais que você já tenha desenvolvido
  • Resposta objetiva (até 10 linhas): “Como você organizaria múltiplos projetos editoriais simultâneos e ao mesmo tempo desenvolveria a frente comercial?”

Enviar para o e-mail: (Precisa enviar tudo por e-mail)


Colocar no título do e-mail: Head Projetos & Comercial


*Fundamental informar sua pretensão salarial no e-mail e disponibilidade para início do trabalho (temos urgência).


*Candidaturas sem portfólio, exemplo de proposta comercial e resposta à pergunta estratégica não serão analisadas.

title: Correção de Redação
description:
A Filadd é uma edtech internacional, presente no cotidiano de mais de 2.000.000 de estudantes no Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia e Chile rumo ao ingresso na universidade. No Brasil, oferecemos aos nossos orientandos e orientandas um acompanhamento pedagógico de alta personalização para que se preparem para o ENEM e os Vestibulares de forma inteligente, através de trajetórias de aprendizagem individualizadas. Somos conhecidos como o cursinho online mais presencial do país!


Perfil da Equipe Filadd


● Diversidade: Todes são bem-vindes!

● Esta vaga é aberta a todas as pessoas. Encorajamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e de pessoas pretas, pardas e indígenas. Respeito e acolhimento a todas as diversidades fundamentam os nossos valores.

● Visão inclusiva da Educação.

● Autonomia, flexibilidade e capacidade de aprendizagem.

● Empatia, escuta ativa, comunicação assertiva, respeitosa e inclusiva.

● Familiaridade com tecnologias digitais e de trabalho remoto.

● Respeito, gentileza e cordialidade sempre, para com todas as pessoas.


Requisitos e qualificações para a posição


● Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência no Pré-Vestibular, como professora | professor | plantonista de Redação ou como pessoa corretora de Redação nos modelos ENEM e Vestibulares Estaduais. Esta experiência é imprescindível .

● Disponibilidade de 4 horas ou mais, por dia, de segunda a sexta. Esta disponibilidade é também imprescindível.

● Graduação em Letras.

● Identificação com o perfil da Equipe Filadd;

● Familiaridade com as ferramentas de trabalho do Google Workspace;

● Boa comunicação e domínio da Língua Portuguesa, na escrita e na oralidade;

● Conhecimento sobre o ENEM, os Vestibulares e as Universidades brasileiras.


Serão diferenciais para esta posição:


● Experiências de correção junto a bancas oficiais de Vestibulares.

● Conhecimentos em Metodologias de Aprendizagem Ativa e Educação Socioemocional.

● Conhecimentos sobre a Linguagem Inclusiva.

● Cursos de pós-graduação e outras formações em Educação.

● Disponibilidade superior a 4 horas por dia, de segunda a sexta.


O que esperamos para esta posição?


Estudantes da Filadd contam com um acompanhamento individual por parte da Equipe de Redação, no desenvolvimento de sua autoria e autonomia na escrita de acordo com a nossa abordagem metodológica, para que possam escrever qualquer tipo de texto para as bancas do ENEM e Vestibulares sem que dependam de modelos prontos de redação.

Para isto, oferecemos os serviços de Mentoria de Redação e de Correção de Redação. Esta correção, diferente das correções de banca, é uma correção pedagógica, com o objetivo de apontar com clareza ao estudante todos os aspectos que deve desenvolver no seu texto. Os dois serviços estão fundamentalmente conectados, partilhando o objetivo de desenvolver a escrita do estudante.

Você integrará a equipe como pessoa Corretora de Redação, e estará em contato constante com a Coordenação Pedagógica do curso. Ao iniciar suas atividades conosco, você passará por um processo formativo completo e terá todo o suporte de que precisar.

O trabalho será realizado de forma 100% remota, e sua jornada será flexível, segundo os horários que você disponibilizar. A contratação será via PJ, com remuneração de acordo com as horas trabalhadas, com proposta de bônus por produtividade em relação às suas entregas.


Como se candidatar?


● IMPORTANTE : Envie seu currículo para .

● Não será aceita somente a candidatura simplificada via LinkedIn. Envie-a necessariamente por email .

● Coloque necessariamente no assunto: Processo Seletivo - Equipe Correção de Redação

● Não envie seu currículo Lattes.

● Inclua no corpo do texto a sua disponibilidade semanal.


Sua candidatura será muito bem-vinda!

Te aguardamos!

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Enterprise Account Manager — HR Technology (LATAM)
description:
About Cadient


Cadient Talent is an AI-enabled hiring platform helping large employers attract, hire, and retain hourly and distributed workforces at scale. Our platform combines ATS technology, automation, and AI-driven recruiting workflows to help organizations:

  • Reduce time-to-hire
  • Increase applicant conversion
  • Improve hiring outcomes for high-volume workforces


Cadient serves enterprise employers across industries including healthcare, hospitality, retail, and service businesses. We are building the next generation of AI-powered hiring infrastructure used by some of the largest hiring organizations in the United States.


The Role

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Manager based in Latin America to manage and grow relationships with US-based enterprise clients. You will act as the primary relationship owner for HR and Talent Acquisition leaders, ensuring they achieve measurable hiring results using the Cadient platform. This role is responsible for client retention, revenue expansion, and strategic account management. You will operate as a trusted advisor, helping clients optimize hiring performance while identifying opportunities to expand their use of Cadient solutions.


Key Responsibilities


Own Client Relationships

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customer accounts in the United States
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for HR and talent acquisition leaders
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) analyzing hiring performance and platform usage
  • Ensure strong platform adoption, satisfaction, and measurable outcomes
  • Monitor client health signals and proactively resolve risks


Drive Revenue Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to expand platform usage and services
  • Drive renewals, upsells, and cross-sells
  • Build expansion pipelines within existing accounts
  • Work closely with sales leadership on strategic account growth


Coordinate Across Teams

  • Partner with product, support, and implementation teams
  • Ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally
  • Bring customer insights back to internal teams to improve product and service delivery


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3–6 years experience in account management, customer success, or SaaS client management
  • Experience working with US-based customers
  • Fluent English communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable discussing business outcomes, ROI, and performance metrics
  • Experience working remotely across US time zones


Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, SaaS, or recruiting platforms
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Workday, iCIMS, UKG, Paradox, or similar
  • Experience working with enterprise HR or talent acquisition teams
  • Experience supporting high-volume hiring industries
  • Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.


What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Strong platform adoption and client satisfaction
  • Consistent upsell and expansion opportunities
  • Clear communication of account risks and opportunities
  • Strong internal collaboration with sales, product, and support teams


What You'll Be Responsible For in the First 90 Days

  • Build relationships with 20–40 active US client accounts
  • Conduct your first client performance and strategy reviews
  • Identify 3–5 expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Develop strong working relationships with internal product and support teams
  • Gain deep familiarity with Cadient’s hiring platform and workflows


This Role Is NOT a Fit If

  • You are looking for an entry-level customer support role
  • You are uncomfortable owning revenue retention and upsells
  • You prefer task execution instead of client-facing strategy
  • You are not comfortable speaking directly with US enterprise clients in English


Why Join Cadient

  • Work with a growing HR technology company serving large US employers
  • Be part of the AI transformation of hiring
  • Fully remote role based in Latin America
  • Exposure to enterprise HR leaders and large-scale hiring operations
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based upside


Application Note

When applying, please include a short paragraph answering the following question:

What is one thing most SaaS companies do wrong in customer success?


Applications without this answer may not be considered!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.

Qualificações Desejáveis

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

description:
LMS Implementation Consultants (Senior & Junior)


  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Hiring Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – Independent Contractor | Monthly Invoicing


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a leading edtech services company specializing in the design and delivery of impactful e-learning experiences that empower learners and drive organizational growth. We partner with global leaders such as Google, AWS, Microsoft, VMware, Meta, and Coursera to deliver world-class technical education programs. Many of our solutions include immersive, hands-on labs that help learners build practical, job-ready skills at scale.


As our Learning Technology practice continues to grow, we are expanding our LMS implementation capability to support enterprise clients globally.


Senior LMS Implementation Consultant

We are seeking an experienced Senior LMS Implementation Consultant to join our Learning Technology team. This role is ideal for a seasoned consultant with strong hands-on experience implementing and configuring enterprise LMS platforms.


While experience with Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) is highly desirable, we will provide full training and certification. We welcome applications from experienced LMS implementation consultants with expertise in platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Moodle, Docebo, Totara, Oracle Learning, or similar enterprise LMS solutions.


You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle—working closely with clients to design scalable learning solutions, lead configuration activities, and ensure successful adoption of the LMS platform across diverse organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end LMS implementations, enhancements, and platform optimizations
  • Act as subject-matter expert across LMS functionality including user structures, curricula, certifications, permissions, integrations, and reporting
  • Translate business and learning requirements into scalable system configurations
  • Design learning architectures aligned with organizational and compliance goals
  • Advise clients on LMS best practices, governance models, and release updates
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and post-go-live support
  • Develop and maintain high-quality configuration and process documentation
  • Collaborate with project management, instructional design, and technical teams
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to continuous improvement of delivery standards


Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on LMS implementation or consulting experience
  • Proven experience delivering LMS solutions for mid-sized or enterprise organizations
  • Strong understanding of LMS concepts (curricula, certifications, user management, roles/permissions, reporting, integrations)
  • Experience with data migrations, imports/exports, and system integrations
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Professional, consultative approach with the ability to lead workshops and guide decision-making


Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)
  • Experience with enterprise LMS platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Docebo, Moodle, Totara, or Oracle Learning
  • Familiarity with SCORM, AICC, xAPI
  • Experience in HRIS, talent management, or L&D transformation programs


Junior LMS Implementation Consultant

We are also hiring a Junior LMS Implementation Consultant to support the delivery of LMS implementation projects. This role is suited to professionals with early experience in LMS administration, system configuration, or SaaS implementation who are looking to develop into a senior consulting career path.


Full training will be provided on Cornerstone OnDemand and other enterprise LMS platforms. We welcome candidates with experience across a range of LMS systems or related SaaS platforms.


You will work closely with senior consultants to configure systems, support clients, and contribute to successful implementation outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support LMS configuration and implementation activities
  • Assist with requirements gathering and documentation
  • Configure user structures, learning items, assignments, and reporting under supervision
  • Support data uploads, testing cycles, and user acceptance testing
  • Provide post-go-live support and basic troubleshooting
  • Develop user guides and configuration documentation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams


Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–3 years of experience in LMS administration, SaaS implementation, or similar system-based role
  • Familiarity with LMS concepts such as users, courses, curricula, certifications, and reporting
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured implementation processes
  • Good communication skills and a client-focused mindset
  • Eagerness to learn and develop in a consulting environment

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.


Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

 • Support Valere Digital's design strategy and ensure alignment with broader company objectives.

 • Foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation across the UX/UI team.

 • Ensure client business goals are met and stakeholders are informed of key design decisions.

 • Proactively identify and resolve dependencies and challenges across engagements.

 • Onboard new team members and maintain quality and consistency across design efforts.

 • Establish and operationalize Valere Digital design processes, templates, and deliverables.

 • Maintain a consistent design language and formal design system.

 • Support Valere-related marketing efforts and contribute to creative strategy and budgeting.

 • Promote a collaborative, knowledge-sharing team culture.


Qualifications


Core Design

 • 5+ years of product design experience leading end-to-end UX/UI for complex digital products.

 • Mastery of IA, interaction design, visual design, and design systems.

 • Proficiency in Figma or equivalent tools; strong prototyping and specification skills.

 • Experience leading design reviews and presenting to executive stakeholders.


AI-Native Product Design

 • Demonstrated experience designing AI-native products where AI is core to the user experience —

  including conversational interfaces, copilots, agentic flows, or ML-powered features.

 • Ability to design for AI-specific behaviors: uncertainty, latency, streaming outputs,

  multi-turn interactions, and confidence signaling.

 • Experience collaborating with AI/ML engineers to bridge technical constraints with

  user-centered design.


AI Tools for Design Acceleration

 • Demonstrated use of AI-powered tools to augment and expedite rapid prototyping and design

  iteration — such as Galileo AI, Uizard, Figma AI, v0 by Vercel, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly,

  or equivalent platforms.

 • Proven ability to integrate AI-assisted workflows into team practice while maintaining

  design quality, coherence, and client standards.

 • Skilled in prompting and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs — using AI to

  augment design judgment, not replace it.


Leadership

 • Experience leading and mentoring designers in a client-facing or agency environment.

 • Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements and competing priorities.

 • Track record of contributing to or establishing design systems and organizational UX standards.


Portfolio Requirement


Candidates must submit a portfolio that includes:


 • At least one AI-native UX/UI project (shipped or prototype) where AI is central to the experience - demonstrating how you handled model outputs, uncertainty, and human-AI interaction.

 • Additional entries showing end-to-end design ownership across enterprise digital products.

 • At least one case study walking through your full design process.


Portfolios without demonstrated AI-native design experience will not be considered.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Gerente de cozinha
description:
Sobre a Cumbuca Boa,


A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a fast-food por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?

Para nós da Cumbuca Boa, 15 minutos é tempo de sobra para preparar refeições saborosas e saudáveis! A Cumbuca Boa nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade, e que ao mesmo tempo atenda os desafios da vida moderna.

A empresa tem como propósito revitalizar a imagem da comida instantânea, proporcionando refeições ultrarrápidas e com a qualidade de comida feita em casa.

Nossa missão é encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.


Por que trabalhar na Cumbuca Boa?


Na nossa Cumbuca, os principais ingredientes são amor e carinho. Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar. Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe qualidade. Procuramos fazer as coisas bem-feitas Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe diversidade. Nossa cultura é inclusiva Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe proatividade. Gostamos de gente que faz Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe criatividade. Novas ideias são sempre bem-vindas. Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe cooperação. Cultivamos um ambiente onde todos constroem juntos. Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição, não temos limite para crescer. Na nossa Cumbuca, cabem todos os sonhos do mundo. Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!


Sobre o nosso processo seletivo

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

Arquitetura e Cloud

  • Experiência prática com AWS e conceitos de serverless/microsserviços.

Diferenciais

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor's degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações para atuar na liderança e gestão de projetos, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, controle e execução de projetos industriais, navais e de óleo e gás, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, segurança e requisitos contratuais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir conformidade com as Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35, requisitos IACS, ABS, DNV e exigências dos clientes;

  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;

Requisitos e qualificações

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
About you

You are a senior-level DevOps Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You're comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps, Terraform, or similar (preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.
